headline: South Africa Producer Inflation Accelerates to 6.2% as Lending Slows
summary: South Africa's producer price index rose 6.2% in September while credit extension and M3 money supply growth moderated, presenting a policy challenge for the South African Reserve Bank.
why: Producer price data feed directly into South African headline consumer inflation, impacting interest rate policy decisions by the South African Reserve Bank.

impacts.name: South Africa policy rate
impacts.why: A pickup in PPI to 6.2% complicates monetary easing prospects for the Reserve Bank.
